metadata.title: Use pagination for user APIs and UI
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
# ✨ Feature / Enhancement PR

## 🔗 Epic / Issue
_Link to the epic or parent issue:_
Updates points in #1224

---

## 🚀 Summary (1-2 sentences)
Refactored team member addition UI to support bulk operations with paginated user selection, inline role assignment, and search functionality.

## Key Changes

### Team Member Management

- Split UX: Separated "view members" and "add members" into distinct screens
- Bulk addition: Add multiple users simultaneously instead of one-at-a-time
- Pre-selection: Existing team members are automatically checked when opening add members view
- Per-user roles: Each user has their own role dropdown (member/owner) instead of global role selection

### User Selector Component

- Pagination: Infinite scroll with HTMX for large user lists (20 users per page)
- Search: Real-time user search by name or email via /admin/users/search endpoint
- Team context: User selector fetches and pre-selects current team members
- Role dropdowns: Inline dropdowns enabled/disabled based on checkbox state

### API Improvements
- admin_add_team_members (renamed from admin_add_team_member): Handles both single and bulk user addition with per-user roles
- admin_users_partial_html: New endpoint for paginated HTML partials with render=selector mode
- admin_search_users: New JSON search endpoint
- list_users() service method: Enhanced with search, pagination, and team filtering support

### Templates

- users_selector_items.html: Reusable user selector with checkboxes, role dropdowns, and infinite scroll
- users_partial.html: Paginated user list for admin UI
- team_add_members.html: Created but not yet integrated (HTML currently inline in admin.py)

### Technical Details
- Uses HTMX for dynamic content loading without page refreshes
- JavaScript event delegation for dynamically loaded checkboxes
- Proper scoping to support multiple simultaneous team modals
- Backward compatible: supports legacy single-user addition mode


---

## 🧪 Checks

- [x] `make lint` passes
- [x] `make test` passes

commits.message:
fix: remove redundant API call and fix XSS vulnerability in user search

- Remove duplicate list_users call in admin_list_users endpoint
- Fix XSS vulnerability in user search JavaScript by using DOM methods
  (createElement, textContent) instead of innerHTML with template literals

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: use orjson to safely serialize member emails for JavaScript

Replace vulnerable string concatenation with orjson.dumps() to prevent
potential JavaScript injection attacks. The JSON serialization properly
escapes special characters, ensuring safe embedding in JavaScript code.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: address security issues and configure bandit

- Add html.escape() for team.name to prevent XSS
- Add nosec B105 comment for orjson email serialization (not a password)
- Configure bandit to skip B608 (false positives on HTML templates)
- Update Makefile to use pyproject.toml for bandit config

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
